title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Build Their Own Feedback for Recursive Self-Improvement?
abstract: arXiv:2610.04184v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) relies on evaluation feedback to assess progress and guide further research, yet repeatedly running complex benchmarks is costly and slows iteration. Human experts reduce this cost by selecting benchmark subsets or designing compact suites. We ask whether AI agents can automate this design process and introduce EvalResearchBench (ERB), a benchmark for autonomous evaluation research. Given target materials, development references, candidate APIs, and fixed time and API budgets, an agent called the researcher selects or synthesizes tasks, implements graders, and revises them in pilot tests before freezing an executable evaluator for coding, co-work, and reasoning. translated_title: EvalResearchBench：AI智能体能否构建自己的反馈以实现递归自我改进？
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）依赖于评估反馈来评估进展并指导后续研究，然而反复运行复杂的基准测试成本高昂且拖慢迭代速度。人类专家通过选择基准测试子集或设计紧凑的测试套件来降低这一成本。我们探讨AI智能体能否自动化这一设计过程，并提出了EvalResearchBench（ERB），一个面向自主评估研究的基准。在给定目标材料、开发参考资料、候选API以及固定时间和API预算的条件下，一个被称为“研究员”的智能体需要选择或合成任务、实现评分器，并在试点测试中进行修订，最终冻结出一个可执行的评估器，用于编程、协作和推理任务。我们研究了9个研究员和13个候选模型，并将每个冻结的评估器与14个目标基准在分数一致性和成对一致性上进行比较。最好的评估器能够以与目标基准相同的方式对约75%的候选对进行排序，低于91%的（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出EvalResearchBench（ERB）这一新基准，用于检验AI智能体能否自主设计评估反馈以支持递归自我改进，研究发现最佳智能体构建的评估器与目标基准的成对排序一致性约为75%，但仍低于人类专家水平。
en_tdlr: Introduces EvalResearchBench (ERB), a benchmark testing whether AI agents can autonomously build their own evaluation feedback for recursive self-improvement, finding that the best agent-designed evaluators agree with target benchmarks on about 75% of pairwise rankings, still below human expert performance.
